title: Grateful Dead Live at Public Hall on 1973-12-06

ai_review.summary: Pitch‑perfect soundboard capture of a glowing 1973 show, highlighted by the restored long “Here Comes Sunshine”.
ai_review.review: The upgraded SBD recording is described as crystal‑clear and perfectly pitched, with superb bass balance that sets a new benchmark for archival releases. Reviewers rave about the now‑complete, extended “Here Comes Sunshine” and overall energy of the performance, calling it one of the year’s best shows.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave five‑star ratings, consistently praising both the flawless recording quality and the musical performance, especially the restored “Here Comes Sunshine”.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Pitch‑corrected, crystal‑clear balance with strong bass; audience bleed at the end of “Here Comes Sunshine” cleaned up; overall pristine and “gold standard” sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Not detailed in reviews, but listeners note a seamless flow throughout the concert.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised indirectly; reviewer hopes Jerry is smiling at the flawless sound.
band_member_comments.Phil: Great bass balance highlighted as pitch‑perfect.
